title: Continuity of the inverse of a Simon local representation on W ∩ M (Simon 2.4.2)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, V ⊆ ℝⁿ, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ satisfy IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ: V and W are open, ψ is C^r on V, ψ is injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(x) is injective for every x ∈ V. Let g := Function.invFunOn ψ V : ℝᴺ → ℝⁿ. Here g(y) is a point of V mapped to y by ψ whenever such a point exists, and a fixed arbitrary point of ℝⁿ otherwise. Then g is continuous on W ∩ M in the relative topology, that is, ContinuousOn g (W ∩ M).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ContinuousOn (Function.invFunOn ψ V) (W ∩ M)
